title: Pan-Seared Herring with Arabian Flamb Sauce
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the richness of herring with the spices of the Arabian Peninsula.

ingredients.name: saudi spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Rinse the herring fillets under cold water and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a shallow dish, mix together the arabian flamb sauce, luscious lemons, and saudi spices.
Dust the herring fillets with aerated all-purpose flour, shaking off any excess.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the herring fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the herring is cooked through.
Serve the pan-seared herring with the arabian flamb sauce spooned over the top.
